# {display_name} app icon pack

{description}

## Files ({file_count})

This pack contains the same design at the following sizes: {size_list}.

Every `-{{size}}.png` file is PNG **with an alpha channel**. Files ending `-opaque.png` are the same design flattened onto a solid background for stores that reject transparency.

## Recommended use

- iOS / iPadOS App Store: use `-1024-opaque.png` in App Store Connect. App Store Connect rejects icons that contain an alpha channel (ITMS-90717), so the transparent 1024 file will not pass. Apple applies its own rounded-corner mask, so submit the full square and do not pre-round it.
- macOS .icns generators: feed in the 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024 sizes (transparency is expected here).
- Android Play Store: use the 512x512 file.
- Android launcher icon: use 192x192 (xxxhdpi) — closest in this pack is 256.
- Web favicon: use 32x32 for the standard favicon, 180x180 for apple-touch-icon.
- Slack / Discord workspace icon: use the 512x512 file.
